response:
All rules verified with zero errors. Deliverables are in place.

**What I produced** (in `out/`):

`out/纪要.docx` — title paragraph "云岭数据看板项目会议纪要", then the three sections with headings verbatim `一、决议事项` / `二、待办事项` / `三、风险与关注`:

- **决议事项 (3)**, numbered `N. 【决议事项 · 相关人】内容`
- **待办事项 (4)**, a 3-column table headed 事项 / 负责人 / 期限
- **风险与关注 (2)**, numbered in the same bracketed format

`out/summary.json` — `{"决议事项": 3, "待办事项": 4, "风险与关注": 2, "合计": 9}`, matching the actual item counts.

**How I handled the two recording defects:**

- *No timestamps*: nothing of the form `[HH:MM]` appears anywhere. I added a regex guard in the generator that fails the build if one ever does.
- *Same-name speakers*: the confusable pair is 徐志远 / 吴志远. Entries attributed to either get the `（归属待核）` suffix; entries by 周丽娜, 吴雨桐, 刘晓雯 do not. I did not invent any 甲/乙 or department labels to disambiguate.

Every item's content is a verbatim substring of a transcript line — I verified this programmatically (a build-time trace check plus an independent re-read of the docx, which reported no errors). Where the transcript gave no time limit (吴志远's 责任分工梳理, 周丽娜's 发群里), 期限 is `未明确`; the other two carry 下周一 and 本周五.

I also left `build_minutes.py` in the working directory — it regenerates both artifacts and re-runs the traceability checks. One environment note worth knowing: `python-docx` is installed under `/usr/bin/python3`, not the `ml` venv that `python3` resolves to on PATH, so I ran the script with the absolute interpreter path.
